textRuns.value: Cleaning rules: duplicates removed on natural keys · region / sex / channel normalised · states to postal codes · BMI outside 12–70 nulled and imputed by sex × age band (flag kept) · screenings count only with a documented date inside the guideline interval · wearable plausibility: steps 1–50,000, sleep 2–16 h, resting HR 35–200 · events outside enrolment→snapshot dropped. Control thresholds: BP < 140/90, HbA1c < 8.0 %, LDL < 130 mg/dL. Risk tiers: Low 0–3 · Moderate 4–7 · High 8–11 · Very High 12+.
